title: Characterization of the structural and functional composition of the gut microbiome and its impact on metabolism in Fontan patients: An international, multicenter, prospective Study
summary: The FONTOMICS study investigates 200 patients with Fontan circulation. Its aim is to analyse changes in gut bacteria and specific blood components to identify early signs of cardiovascular deterioration and potential complications. Blood, urine and stool samples, as well as clinical data, will be collected during routine follow-up examinations. In addition, household members of the patients will be included as a control group.
conditions: Fontan patients, with a particular focus on those with protein-losing enteropathy (PLE)

interventions.name: Fontan patients will have a blood sample taken once as part of a routine examination, and a  urine and stool sample will be analyzed. In addition, data from the routine examination (medical history, echocardiography, cardiac MRI, and cardiac catheterization) will be collected
Control group: A one-time stool sample will be collected and analyzed from household members of the patients

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Informed consent from the legal guardians and/or patients
- Fontan circulation established for more than 1 year
- Fasting prior to blood sampling
Exclusion criteria:
- Lack of informed consent from the legal guardians and/or patients.
